		<div class="releases"><h2>Synopsis Beyond Time’s Gaze</h2></div>
		<div class="entry-content" itemprop="description">
			<p>English<br />
The world was a temporary dwelling for all beings, and time flowed like passing travelers. Where the shattered sky opened its eerie eye, life perished and zones became forbidden. In the apocalypse, consequences followed, and life arose from death.</p>
<p>Indonesia</p>
<p>Dunia adalah tempat sementara bagi semua makhluk hidup dan waktu tetap berlalu. Kekejaman dunia membuka mata yang penuh ketakutan, hal yang dilihat juga menjadi kabur dan berubah menjadi tempat terlarang yang abadi. Dalam kehancuran dunia, hukum karma menyertai, hidup kembali setelah kematian.</p>
<p>Beyond Time’s Gaze Subtitle Indonesia, English, Portuguese, Turkish, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Arabic, Thai, German, Bangla</p>

    <div class="wpd-tooltip-content">
        <a class='wc_tw' rel='noreferrer' target='_blank' href='https://x.com/intent/post?text=Beyond Time&#8217;s Gaze (Guang Yin Zhi Wai) is an absolute must-watch 3D donghua ... &url=https%3A%2F%2Fanimexin.dev%2Fbeyond-times-gaze%2F%23comment-91056' title='Share On X'><i class='wpf-cta' aria-hidden='true'><svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 512 512'><path d='M389.2 48h70.6L305.6 224.2 487 464H345L233.7 318.6 106.5 464H35.8L200.7 275.5 26.8 48H172.4L272.9 180.9 389.2 48zM364.4 421.8h39.1L151.1 88h-42L364.4 421.8z'/></svg></i></a>
    </div>
</div>
    <div class="wpd-space"></div>
    <div class="wpd-comment-link wpd-hidden">
    <span wpd-tooltip='Comment Link' wpd-tooltip-position='left'><i class='fas fa-link' aria-hidden='true' data-wpd-clipboard='https://animexin.dev/beyond-times-gaze/#comment-91056'></i></span>
</div>
</div>
    
    <div class="wpd-comment-text">
    <p>Beyond Time&#8217;s Gaze (Guang Yin Zhi Wai) is an absolute must-watch 3D donghua that turns Er Gen’s post-apocalyptic xianxia into a relentless, cinematic masterpiece. Stripping away generic tropes, the story delivers razor-sharp pacing centered on a coldly pragmatic, hitman-like protagonist fighting for survival in a toxic, god-corrupted world. Visually, Yien Animation Studio excels with gritty, high-fidelity graphics, dark atmospheric lighting, and brutally weighty, gory combat choreography that hits with visceral impact—making it a top-tier standout in modern Chinese animation.</p>

</div>
    <div class="wpd-comment-footer">

    <script type="text/javascript">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const DM_PLAYER_ID = 'xhojl';

        function fixDailymotionIframe(iframe) {
            let src = iframe.getAttribute('src');
            if (src && src.includes('dailymotion.com/embed/video/')) {
                let videoId = src.split('/embed/video/')[1].split('?')[0];
                let newSrc = 'https://geo.dailymotion.com/player/' + DM_PLAYER_ID + '.html?video=' + videoId;
                iframe.setAttribute('src', newSrc);
            }
        }

        // Cek semua iframe saat pertama kali halaman selesai dimuat
        document.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(fixDailymotionIframe);

        // Pantau perubahan DOM (misal saat tab server diklik & iframe baru/src berubah)
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'src') {
                    fixDailymotionIframe(mutation.target);
                } else if (mutation.type === 'childList') {
                    mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
                        if (node.tagName === 'IFRAME') {
                            fixDailymotionIframe(node);
                        } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                            node.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(fixDailymotionIframe);
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, {
            childList: true,
            subtree: true,
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['src']
        });
    });
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
        // Fungsi untuk menyuntikkan referrerpolicy ke iframe Rumble
        function fixRumbleIframes() {
            var iframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src*="rumble.com"]');
            iframes.forEach(function(iframe) {
                if (!iframe.getAttribute('referrerpolicy')) {
                    iframe.setAttribute('referrerpolicy', 'no-referrer');
                    // Reload iframe agar browser menerapkan aturan policy baru
                    var currentSrc = iframe.src;
                    iframe.src = currentSrc;
                }
            });
        }

        // Jalankan langsung saat DOM siap
        fixRumbleIframes();

        // Pantau jika tema memuat iframe secara dinamis (AJAX/Click)
        var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            fixRumbleIframes();
        });

        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
    </script>
